item.text: Verification is clean. I’m pulling line references for the structural changes so I can summarize exactly what was reorganized and why it’s easier to maintain now.

Refactored the tree so node instances no longer carry their own copy of the minimum degree. `Node` is now a non-static inner type that reads sizing and median rules from `BTree`, which removes a duplicated invariant and centralizes the structural rules in one place ([BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:78), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:89), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:101), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:177)). I also added `insertAll(int... keys)` and removed the old traversal/printing convenience layer, so the public API is more focused on data operations instead of mixed I/O concerns ([BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:16), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:26), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:71)).

I also moved the shared sample configuration into [BTreeSamples.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTreeSamples.java:1), so the demo and tests now build trees from one source of truth instead of duplicating constants and insertion loops ([Main.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/Main.java:2), [BTreeTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTreeTest.java:31)). That reduces drift and makes future changes to sample scenarios cheaper.

Verified with `javac BTree.java BTreeSamples.java Main.java BTreeTest.java`, `java -cp . Main`, and `java -cp . BTreeTest`.
